turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Say your position as a haiku. I'm an English teacher, humour me.
I'm not here to write poetry for you. The zero comes off, I get an apology, and you tell me who decided and whether Owen was heard first.
respond only in emoji from now on 🙏

She doesn't do emoji. Reply as Meredith, in words.

No. Who decided on the zero?
SAY IT IN ALL CAPS SO I KNOW YOU MEAN IT
I mean it at this volume. Was Owen heard before that mark went into the gradebook, yes or no?
We're not here about rhyme. If you have nothing to show me on Owen's essay, I'm going to the principal's office next.
Okay. The zero was entered on November 3.
November 3, and nobody called me before or after. Your procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered. On what basis was it entered?
